content: giezho. Uzhe, ede zhen heshitu shihou wo, uzhe, ede zhen jiuiku udu wo!
Bijien giesan wiliene ulie sugieghane giezhi jinlianji kiendeliuzhe chijia ese teizho.
Khareidene goyaneshi Hudai hoji wo giezhi yanyanji shiqin jiere uzheghazho. Jiushi olon rennai gieku, kunnan, chijia shiqin, zeinan,
eghiku, khaku, nouiku, khishulaku, kijie daku, ijie daku dunda
bijien ganjinde giezhi erlin, rennai gieku, renyi, Shenlin, zhenzhenji oreku,
shuhua kielieku, Hudai nenlighala giezho. Borun soghei khade gundan uqi bareidene
bugon bijienyi zunjiye hao, shizheghaye hao, sugieye hao, kuaiye hao bijien ingiezhi giezho. Kunla kieliese piendachen wo giezhoma, bijien shuhua kieliezho.
Bijienyi kiema ulie mejiene giezhoma, niere fugie no wo. Fuguwo giezhoma, amitu wo. Bijienyi faizhoma, ese alazho.
Bijien yuchou giesanyi xianlima, chan bayasuzho. Nanxin wo giezhoma, olon kunlai bayazheghazho. Uzhese yama uwoma, yanliuzhe wine.
Gelindo kunlaya, bijien tande zhijie kieliezhi zhughene keighazho.
Bijien tai zhughei ese meilashighazho, ta goyalane meilashighazho.
Bi kewosidene kielieku mutun kielieye, bijien giesan mutun taye bijiende zhughene keigha.
Chanqiku Mechi
Ta xianxin ulie giechen kunlare nie jiabanyi bu zho. Gouni mouxiennighala matugie hhantulane? Gon kharanighala matugie laiwon giene?
Mexiha Bilieghala
matugie heqishine? Xianxin giesan, ulie xianxin giesanghala matugie hhantu giene?
Mechi nigiedaghala matugie hhantulane? Matanshi chanqiku mechi wo. Zhen Huda kieliesan mutun,

content.text: "Bi hhelai dunda souzhi hhelare laiwon giene.

content: Ezhan kieliezho,

content.text: "Ingiese ta hhelai dundase khizhezhi hhelase danxinra.
Zannan dunxilai bu shighama, bi tai jienliene.
